positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web applications used by external medical professionals. Worked within strict security guidelines. Took part in obtaining FDA clearance. Learned to develop flexible, reusable code. Consistently completed work on time and with quality.

Projects

PatientCare Portal
 - Web portal that consumed data from a remote heart monitor
 - Developed system for institution based configurations
 - Performance tuned for high scalability
 - Worked effectively and efficiently with QA to resolve defects
 - Integrated with a third party for enhanced arrhythmia classification
 - Developed a provider portal used for managing a patient's care plan and administering patient education by Mayo Clinic
 - Worked with REST services that interacted with mobile devices
 - Assisted in the development of a weight loss management tool

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and supported internal software applications. Learned to work Present with different technologies quickly and effectively all while providing quality services and solutions. Consistently exhorted ability to find inefficient processes and identify automated solutions to increase productivity. Gained a working knowledge of ITIL processes.

Projects

 Completed 3+ years of backlogged enhancement tasks for internal Project Tracking
 system using Classic ASP and Oracle
 Configured reporting portal using SQL Server Reporting Services for internal Project
 Tracking system
 Developed integration between Project Tracking system and Windows SharePoint
 Services 3.0 for document storage
 Assisted with the installation and configuration of Windows SharePoint Services 3.0 for
 document storage
 Established process and system to audit user access to critical systems
 Redesigned database schema for internal identity management system to allow for better
 reporting and maintenance
 Integrated newScale RequestCenter with internal identity management system to increase
 efficiency
 Integrated newScale RequestCenter with Microsoft Exchange 2007 to create Distribution
 Groups and Public Folders
 Integrated newScale RequestCenter with VMware to create virtual machines
 Integrated newScale RequestCenter with Active Directory to add users to Groups
 Created reporting portal for internal identity management system with SQL Server
 Reporting Services

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Adapted to changes while developing in-house applications. Utilized problem solving skills in development projects. Demonstrated communication skills in gathering requirements with team members. Managed time well with school and work schedule.

Projects

     Created a time management system for Learner Support Services
     Developed an asset management system for the IT Department
     Assisted with the database and application design for numerous applications

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked as part of a team of 6 to develop meaningful software for a large scale insurance company. Developed analytical skills in determining customer requirements. 
Strengthened problem solving and analytical skills through web development. Displayed strong ability to learn new technologies and gain new skills.

Projects

Documented database table structure of 200+ tables with Microsoft Visio
Helped design and develop integration with ADP
Participated in the Agile Development lifecycle
Developed system created documents via XML and XSLT
